_comment: Discord channel types from the official Channel Types table. Values are plain integers, not bitfields.

channel_types.name: GUILD_TEXT
channel_types.description: A text channel within a server

channel_types.name: GUILD_VOICE
channel_types.description: A voice channel within a server

channel_types.name: GROUP_DM
channel_types.description: A direct message between multiple users

channel_types.name: GUILD_CATEGORY
channel_types.description: An organizational category that contains up to 50 channels

channel_types.name: GUILD_ANNOUNCEMENT
channel_types.description: A channel that users can follow and crosspost into their own server (formerly news channels)

channel_types.name: ANNOUNCEMENT_THREAD
channel_types.description: A temporary sub-channel within a GUILD_ANNOUNCEMENT channel

channel_types.name: PUBLIC_THREAD
channel_types.description: A temporary sub-channel within a GUILD_TEXT or GUILD_FORUM channel

channel_types.name: PRIVATE_THREAD
channel_types.description: A temporary sub-channel within a GUILD_TEXT channel that is only viewable by those invited and those with the MANAGE_THREADS permission

channel_types.name: GUILD_STAGE_VOICE
channel_types.description: A voice channel for hosting events with an audience

channel_types.name: GUILD_DIRECTORY
channel_types.description: The channel in a student hub containing the listed servers

channel_types.name: GUILD_FORUM
channel_types.description: Channel that can only contain threads

channel_types.name: GUILD_MEDIA
channel_types.description: Channel that can only contain threads, similar to GUILD_FORUM channels
